package.name: ur_screw_kinematics
package.description:
Screw theory based kinematics library for Universal Robots. Provides forward and inverse kinematics using Product of Exponentials (PoE) formulation, Jacobian computation, and analytical IK solvers.
Based on screw theory concepts from: - "Screw Theory in Robotics" by Dr. Jose M. Pardos-Gotor - "Modern Robotics" by Kevin Lynch and Frank Park
